name: RoDEM
description: Evaluates robustness of monocular single-shot depth estimation methods in minimally invasive surgery.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for robustness of depth estimation in minimally invasive surgery, mainly used in surgical vision research rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Domain-specific medical vision benchmark with limited public adoption and likely small-scale data; performance is usually reported with depth-estimation error measures rather than a single standardized score.
